abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.description: Raise your shield as a rallying point: you and every ally within 1 square gain +2 Defense through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Knightly Challenge
abilities.description: Call out an enemy within 3 squares, forcing its attacks to target you while you remain a valid target through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Stand Fast
abilities.description: Steady yourself or an ally within 2 squares, halving the next hit they take.

abilities.name: Anvil Stance
abilities.description: Plant your boots like an anvil: every hit you take is reduced by 3 through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Hammer Slam
abilities.description: Slam an adjacent enemy with your warhammer for 2d6+3. On a hit, it is shaken (−2 to hit) through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: War Chant
abilities.description: Chant a guttural challenge at every enemy within 2 squares; those that fail to resist must attack you through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Unbroken
abilities.description: Grit your tusks and shrug off your wounds, restoring 1d10+3 HP to yourself.

abilities.name: Forge-Bound Guard
abilities.description: Bind yourself to an ally within 2 squares: the next hit aimed at them lands on you instead.

abilities.name: Iron Resolve
abilities.description: Set your armor and jaw: the next hit you take before the end of the next DM phase deals no damage.

abilities.name: Thane's Command
abilities.description: Bellow a thane's command at an enemy within 3 squares, forcing its attacks onto you through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Flame Breath
abilities.description: Exhale a ring of flame: every enemy within 1 square takes 2d6+2 fire damage on a hit.

abilities.name: Scale Ward
abilities.description: Flare your scales: gain +1 Defense, and the next magical hit you take is halved, through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Glare of Warning
abilities.description: Fix an enemy within 3 squares with a tattooed glare; if it fails to resist, it is shaken (−2 to hit) through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Bulwark Oath
abilities.description: Swear to guard yourself or an ally within 2 squares, granting +2 Defense through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Hold the Line
abilities.description: Dare an enemy within 3 squares to come at you, forcing its attacks onto you through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Toppling Blow
abilities.description: Chop at an adjacent enemy's legs for 1d10+4. On a hit, it has one fewer action in the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Bracing Roar
abilities.description: Roar for the clan: you and every ally within 2 squares gain +2 Defense through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Veteran's Cover
abilities.description: Step into the line of fire for an ally within 2 squares: attacks against them take −3 to hit through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Old Grudge
abilities.description: Single out an enemy within 3 squares, forcing its attacks onto you through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Shield Brace
abilities.description: Brace behind your battered shield, gaining +3 Defense through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Belly Laugh
abilities.description: Let out a booming laugh at every enemy within 2 squares; those that fail to resist must attack you through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Thick Hide
abilities.description: Puff up under your furs: every hit you take is reduced by 2 through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Hearty Swig
abilities.description: Take a long swig from your flask and restore 1d8+2 HP to yourself.

abilities.name: Toast to Courage
abilities.description: Raise a toast to yourself or an ally within 3 squares, granting +2 on their next attack roll.

abilities.name: Rallying Bellow
abilities.description: Bellow a drinking song: you and every ally within 2 squares gain +2 Defense through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Come and Get It
abilities.description: Wave your tankard at an enemy within 3 squares, forcing its attacks onto you through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Silken Flurry
abilities.description: Whirl your sickles in two separate strikes against an adjacent enemy, each dealing 1d6+3 on a hit.

abilities.name: Veil Step
abilities.description: Vanish behind your silks and reappear up to 4 squares away; once per phase.

abilities.name: Blood Frenzy
abilities.description: Work yourself into a frenzy: your next hit deals +4 damage.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.description: Swing your greataxe in a wide arc, attacking every enemy within 1 square for 1d10+3.

abilities.name: Shadow Snare
abilities.description: Pin an enemy's shadow within 6 squares; if it fails to resist, it is snared (can't move) through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Shadowlance
abilities.description: Hurl a lance of living shadow at an enemy within 6 squares for 2d6+3 necrotic damage.

abilities.name: Searing Sigil
abilities.description: Brand an enemy within 6 squares with a glowing sigil: your next hit on it deals an extra 1d8.

abilities.name: Glyph Burst
abilities.description: Detonate a glyph on an enemy within 6 squares, attacking it and every enemy within 1 square of it for 1d8+2 arcane damage.

abilities.name: Twin Volley
abilities.description: Loose two arrows at an enemy within 8 squares, each with its own attack roll and 1d8+2 damage.

abilities.name: Pinning Shot
abilities.description: Fire at an enemy within 8 squares for 1d8+3. On a hit, it is pinned in place (snared) through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Predator's Leap
abilities.description: Leap up to 4 squares, then spear an adjacent enemy for 2d6+3. The leap is free movement, but not while snared or toward what frightens you.

abilities.name: Blood Trail
abilities.description: Mark your prey within 8 squares: your next hit on it deals an extra 1d6.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.description: Strike an enemy within 8 squares with lightning that can leap to up to 2 more enemies, each within 3 squares of the last, for 1d8+2 each.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.description: Clap your hands with a peal of thunder, attacking every enemy within 1 square for 1d8+2 thunder damage.

abilities.name: Wither Curse
abilities.description: Curse an enemy within 6 squares; if it fails to resist, its next hit deals half damage (through the next DM phase).

abilities.name: Siphon Life
abilities.description: Drain an enemy within 6 squares for 2d6+2 necrotic damage. On a hit, you regain 1d6+2 HP.

abilities.name: Arcane Barrage
abilities.description: Fire three bolts of force at an enemy within 8 squares, each with its own attack roll and 1d4+2 damage.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.description: Blink up to 5 squares away; once per phase.

abilities.name: Reckless Fury
abilities.description: Hack at an adjacent enemy twice (1d10+3 each), leaving yourself open: −2 Defense until the next player phase.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.description: Fly into a rage and gain one extra action this phase; once per phase.

abilities.name: Raven's Dread
abilities.description: Send a shrieking raven at an enemy within 6 squares; if it fails to resist, it is frightened of you (−2 to hit, can't move closer to you) through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Feather Storm
abilities.description: Engulf an enemy within 6 squares in black feathers, attacking it and every enemy within 1 square of it for 1d8+2 necrotic.

abilities.name: Thunder Step
abilities.description: Vanish in a thunderclap and reappear up to 4 squares away, attacking every enemy within 1 square of where you land for 1d6+3.

abilities.name: Static Surge
abilities.description: Loose a surge of lightning at an enemy within 7 squares that can leap to one more enemy within 3 squares, 2d6+1 each.

abilities.name: Quick Hands
abilities.description: Move faster than the eye can follow and gain one extra action this phase; once per phase.

abilities.name: Backstab
abilities.description: Slip a blade past an adjacent enemy's guard for 2d6+3, treating its Defense as 2 lower.

abilities.name: Infernal Brand
abilities.description: Brand an enemy within 8 squares with an infernal mark: your next hit on it deals an extra 1d8.

abilities.name: Hellfire Burst
abilities.description: Call down hellfire on an enemy within 6 squares, attacking it and every enemy within 1 square of it for 1d8+2 fire.

abilities.name: Steady Aim
abilities.description: Draw a slow breath: +2 on your next attack roll; once per phase.

abilities.name: Crippling Arrow
abilities.description: Shoot an enemy within 10 squares in the leg for 1d8+4. On a hit, it is slowed (−2 movement) through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Duelist's Flurry
abilities.description: Lunge twice at an adjacent enemy, each thrust its own attack for 1d6+3.

abilities.name: Cold Feint
abilities.description: Feint at an adjacent enemy; if it fails to resist, it is shaken (−2 to hit) through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.description: Spin your greatsword in a full circle, attacking every enemy within 1 square for 1d8+3.

abilities.name: Battle Cry
abilities.description: Unleash a sky-splitting battle cry; enemies within 2 squares that fail to resist are shaken (−2 to hit) through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Sand Blast
abilities.description: Blast an enemy within 6 squares with a whirl of sand, attacking it and every enemy within 1 square of it for 1d6+3.

abilities.name: Mischief
abilities.description: Grant an enemy within 6 squares a cursed little wish; if it fails to resist, it has one fewer action in the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.description: Slash at an adjacent enemy's legs for 1d8+3. On a hit, it is slowed (−2 movement) through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Bloodmark
abilities.description: Hurl an axe at an enemy within 5 squares for 1d8+3. On a hit, your next hit on it deals an extra 1d6.

abilities.name: Envenomed Strike
abilities.description: Stab an adjacent enemy with a poisoned blade for 1d10+3 poison damage. On a hit, it is poisoned (−2 to hit) for 5 rounds.

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.description: Slip into the shadows and reappear up to 5 squares away; attacks against you take −3 to hit through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Mending Word
abilities.description: Speak a kindly blessing that heals yourself or an ally within 6 squares for 1d8+3.

abilities.name: Hearty Stew
abilities.description: Ladle out your famous stew: you and every ally within 2 squares heal 1d6+2.

abilities.name: Good Cheer
abilities.description: Cheer on yourself or an ally within 4 squares, granting +2 on their next attack roll.

abilities.name: Chi Restoration
abilities.description: Press your palms to yourself or an adjacent ally, restoring 2d8+3 HP.

abilities.name: Lotus Ward
abilities.description: Wrap yourself or an ally within 3 squares in calm chi, halving the next hit they take.

abilities.name: Purifying Breath
abilities.description: Breathe clarity into yourself or an ally within 3 squares, curing poison and healing 1d4+2.

abilities.name: Warm Embrace
abilities.description: Wrap yourself or an adjacent ally in a warm hug, restoring 2d8+3 HP.

abilities.name: Hearthfire
abilities.description: Kindle a small hearth within 3 squares that heals allies within 2 squares of it for 1d6+1 at the start of the next 2 player phases.

abilities.name: Snowfall Lullaby
abilities.description: Hum an old lullaby that heals yourself or an ally within 6 squares for 1d8+3.

abilities.name: Verdant Pulse
abilities.description: Send a pulse of green life to yourself or an ally within 6 squares that can spread to 2 more wounded allies, healing 1d6+2 each.

abilities.name: Entangle
abilities.description: Call roots up around an enemy within 6 squares; if it fails to resist, it is snared (can't move) through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Rousing Ballad
abilities.description: Belt out a rousing ballad: you and every ally within 2 squares heal 1d6+2.

abilities.name: Inspiring Laugh
abilities.description: Laugh so infectiously that yourself or an ally within 6 squares adds 1d6 to their next attack roll.

abilities.name: Heckle
abilities.description: Heckle an enemy within 6 squares; if it fails to resist, it is shaken (−2 to hit) through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Dawn's Grace
abilities.description: Bathe yourself or an ally within 6 squares in dawnlight, healing 1d8+3.

abilities.name: Aegis of Dawn
abilities.description: Raise a golden shield around yourself or an ally within 4 squares: the next hit they take before the end of the next DM phase deals no damage.

abilities.name: Sanctuary Light
abilities.description: Veil yourself or an ally within 4 squares in holy light: attacks against them take −4 to hit through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Prayer of Mending
abilities.description: Murmur a prayer that heals yourself or an ally within 6 squares for 1d8+3.

abilities.name: Laying on Hands
abilities.description: Lay your hands on yourself or an adjacent ally, restoring 2d8+3 HP.

abilities.name: Benediction
abilities.description: Bless yourself or an ally within 3 squares: the next hit they take is reduced by 6.

abilities.name: Healing Draught
abilities.description: Pour a strong honeyed draught for yourself or an adjacent ally, restoring 2d8+3 HP.

abilities.name: Toss a Tonic
abilities.description: Lob a corked tonic to yourself or an ally within 5 squares, healing 1d8+3.

abilities.name: Warming Spirits
abilities.description: Share a nip of mead with yourself or an ally within 3 squares: it stops them being shaken and grants +1 on their next attack roll.

abilities.name: Joyful Light
abilities.description: Send a bright mote to yourself or an ally within 6 squares that can bounce to 2 more wounded allies, healing 1d6+2 each.

abilities.name: Cleansing Laugh
abilities.description: Laugh away the fear of yourself or an ally within 4 squares: it stops them being frightened and heals 1d6+2.

abilities.name: Spring Totem
abilities.description: Plant a budding totem within 3 squares that heals allies within 2 squares of it for 1d6+2 at the start of the next 2 player phases.

abilities.name: Rejuvenate
abilities.description: Coax fresh growth through yourself or an ally within 6 squares, healing 1d8+3.

abilities.name: Barkskin
abilities.description: Harden the skin of yourself or an ally within 4 squares like bark, granting +2 Defense through the next DM phase.
